_comment: Service Includes per service, extracted verbatim from the app's includesExcludesData (TestServiceDetails.tsx). Keyed by the service name (matched case-insensitively against the Excel ServiceName, ignoring any '* ...' suffix). Add new services here. Unknown services use _default.
Interior Paint Touch-Ups: Exact color matching to existing wall paint
Touch-up of minor scuffs, marks, and chips
Quick and clean service, with minimal disruption to your space
Furniture Assembly: Use of necessary tools for assembly
Basic inspection to ensure all assembled furniture is sturdy and functional
